title: Career Roadmap: Research Assistant
summary: A Research Assistant supports scientific and clinical research by collecting data, reviewing medical literature, assisting with experiments, maintaining research records, and helping research teams analyse and report findings. With a B.Sc. in physiotherapy-related basic sciences, you can explore research in human physiology, anatomy, biomechanics, rehabilitation, exercise science, and musculoskeletal health.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: The exact degree named in this career row may not be a standard programme title at every institution. Eligibility depends on the actual degree subjects and the specific research project's recruitment criteria. A research assistant role does not itself qualify someone to practise as a physiotherapist.

blocks.label: Literature review
blocks.text: Review published evidence on exercise and balance in older adults.

blocks.label: Research poster
blocks.text: Summarise findings from published studies on posture, mobility, or musculoskeletal health.

blocks.label: Public dataset analysis

blocks.label: Scientific abstract
blocks.text: Write a structured abstract based on a literature review or an approved student project.

For studies involving people, patient records, or identifiable health data, obtain the required institutional approvals and permissions before starting. Follow applicable ethics guidance, including the Indian Council of Medical Research's biomedical research guidelines.

blocks.label: Search terms to use
blocks.text: Research Assistant – Physiology, Project Assistant – Biomedical Research, Clinical Research Assistant, Research Intern – Rehabilitation, and Research Intern – Public Health.
Before applying, check each vacancy's required degree, subject specialisation, experience, and technical skills. Some clinical research posts require qualifications beyond a basic B.Sc.
Prioritise courses that create demonstrable skills rather than collecting certificates.

items.text: Entry level — Research Intern / Research Assistant

blocks.text: Support literature reviews, participant scheduling, data collection, documentation, and supervised analysis.

items.text: With experience — Senior Research Assistant / Project Coordinator

blocks.text: Coordinate study activities, maintain project records, monitor timelines, and support reporting.

items.text: With postgraduate specialisation — Clinical Research Associate / Research Analyst

blocks.text: Potential pathways into clinical research operations, data analysis, or specialised biomedical research, depending on qualifications and employer requirements.
Advanced research positions often require a relevant master's degree, Ph.D., substantial experience, or other role-specific qualifications.
Salary expectations in India

Pay varies considerably by employer, city, funding source, experience, and whether the position is a temporary funded project or a permanent role. Government-funded projects may have fixed remuneration specified in their recruitment notice.
For a reliable estimate, compare current vacancies for the exact job title and qualification rather than treating one salary figure as universal.

Research teams increasingly use digital tools for literature screening, electronic data capture, statistical workflows, and AI-assisted analysis. Useful skills include:

items.text: Understanding how to validate AI-generated research summaries against original papers.
Protecting confidential data and avoiding unauthorised uploads of patient information.
Recognising bias, limitations, and reproducibility issues in data analysis.
Learning the responsible use of AI in biomedical research.

blocks.label: Final recommendation
blocks.text: For this career pathway, combine a relevant basic-science degree with research methodology, biostatistics, scientific writing, and at least one supervised research experience. A strong first milestone is a well-documented research project that you can explain clearly in an interview.
